A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MuGS research work, with readable text, equations, figures and tables throughout. Both contain 11 pages ending with references; neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: Section 5 reports original rendering, depth estimation, zero-shot generalization and ablation results for MuGS in Tables 1–6 and Figures 3–8.

after.justification: Section 5 retains the original MuGS experiments and their quantitative and qualitative results in Tables 1–6 and Figures 3–8.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same MVS/MDE fusion, projection-and-sampling depth refinement, Gaussian parameter prediction, hierarchical training and reference-view loss.

E1.justification: Both versions use DTU and RealEstate10K for training and evaluation, with the same zero-shot evaluations on LLFF, Mip-NeRF 360 and DTU. Dataset and task coverage are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within the corresponding comparisons in Tables 1–5 and the qualitative figures, including MuRF, MVSplat and MVSGaussian.

E3.justification: Section 5 retains the same two- and three-view DTU settings, RealEstate10K inputs separated by 128 frames, transfer protocols, and rendering and depth metrics.

E4.justification: Table 6 and Figures 7–8 retain the same feature-enhancement, depth-refinement and reference-loss ablations, including comparisons at the same training iterations. Generalization analyses are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, rankings and qualitative results are unchanged throughout. For example, Tables 1–2 retain MuGS PSNR values of 29.34 and 27.56 for three- and two-view DTU, and 24.82 for RealEstate10K.

T1.justification: Equations 1–11 retain the same mathematical formulations, including homography, depth consistency, attention refinement, Gaussian prediction and the training objective. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims concerning multi-baseline novelty, rendering quality, geometric accuracy, optimization efficiency and zero-shot generalization.

C2.justification: Interpretations of monocular cues, depth refinement and reference-view supervision are unchanged. The conclusion retains the same limitations involving weak textures and specular reflections.

D1.justification: Both versions disclose the same PyTorch/CUDA implementation, 64/16 coarse/fine depth candidates, two Nvidia A6000 GPUs, Adam optimizer, Depth Anything V2 model and code link.

R1.justification: The same 55 references and related-work discussion are retained, including positioning relative to MuRF, MVS-based methods and DepthSplat.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv inscription changes from v1 dated 6 August 2025 to v2 dated 23 October 2025. The paper's wording, headings and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–6 retain their content, captions, structure and placement. Rendered pages preserve the same layout; extraction-spacing differences do not represent a visual redesign.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves v1's methods, evidence, explanations, limitations and reproducibility information. The updated arXiv version/date inscription and negligible rendering differences do not materially improve or impair the paper's overall quality.
